2610.04665.title: Efficient Neural Surrogates for Linear Radiation Transport on the Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks
2610.04665.paper_summary: Linear radiation transport equations (RTEs) form the simulation foundations underpinning design and analysis tasks in nuclear engineering, inertial confinement fusion, medical imaging, and astrophysics, but resolving the high-dimensional phase space at engineering fidelity remains expensive enough that outer-loop workflows, such as design optimization, uncertainty quantification, and parameter sweeps, are routinely budget-bound on traditional solvers. Neural surrogates promise to relax this bottleneck by amortizing simulation cost across thousands of downstream queries, but the architectural choices and engineered inductive biases that make a surrogate accurate on one transport problem do not transfer straightforwardly across model families. We benchmark two parameter-matched neural surrogate architectures, the physics-attention Transolver and the multi-scale graph network Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet (BSMS-MGN), as end-to-end approximations of the final-time particle concentration for the two-dimensional linear RTE on the canonical Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks. An ablation across Fourier features and region-weighted training loss exposes strongly architecture-dependent inductive-bias preferences, indicating that design choices common to physics-informed surrogate workflows must be revisited per architecture rather than imported across model families, and that downstream utility depends on per-QoI sensitivity rather than a single field-level score. The model training recipe, training data, and evaluation pipeline are released alongside this paper to support reproduction, transfer to related transport problems, and evaluation as amortized forward-model components in larger outer-loop simulation workflows.
2610.04665.paper_summary_zh: 線性輻射傳輸方程（RTEs）構成了核工程、慣性約束融合、醫學影像和天體物理學中設計和分析任務的模擬基礎，但在工程精度下解決高維相空間的成本仍然足夠高，使得外部循環工作流程，如設計優化、不確定性量化和參數掃描，常常受到傳統求解器的預算限制。神經代理有望通過在數千個下游查詢中攤銷模擬成本來緩解這一瓶頸，但使代理在一個傳輸問題上準確的架構選擇和工程誘導偏差並不會在模型家族之間直接轉移。我們基準測試了兩個參數匹配的神經代理架構，物理注意力Transolver和多尺度圖網絡Bi-Stride Multi-Scale MeshGraphNet（BSMS-MGN），作為對於典型晶格和Hohlraum基準上二維線性RTE的最終粒子濃度的端到端近似。對傅立葉特徵和區域加權訓練損失的消融實驗揭示了強烈依賴於架構的誘導偏差偏好，表明物理知識驅動的代理工作流程中的設計選擇必須針對每個架構重新考慮，而不是在模型家族之間引入，並且下游效用取決於每個關鍵指標的敏感性，而不是單一的場級分數。模型訓練配方、訓練數據和評估管道與本文一起發布，以支持重現、轉移到相關的傳輸問題，以及作為更大外部循環模擬工作流程中的攤銷前向模型組件進行評估。
